ai|ck: Anguilla and the Cook Islands are both Blue Ensigns with a circle in the fly. Anguilla's circle is three orange dolphins on a white and turquoise shield; the Cook Islands' is a ring of fifteen white stars straight on the blue.
ai|ms: Anguilla and Montserrat are both Caribbean Blue Ensigns with a badge in the fly. Anguilla's badge is three orange dolphins in a circle; Montserrat's is a woman in green with a harp and a cross.
ai|tc: Anguilla and Turks and Caicos are both Blue Ensigns with sea creatures on the badge. Anguilla has three orange dolphins in a circle on white and turquoise; Turks and Caicos has a conch, a lobster and a cactus on a yellow shield.
at|pf: Austria and French Polynesia are both red-white-red horizontal stripes. Austria's stripes are equal and plain; French Polynesia's white band is twice as tall and carries a canoe and sun emblem.
au|ck: Australia and the Cook Islands are both dark blue with the Union Jack and white stars. Australia's stars form the Southern Cross with a large star under the Jack; the Cook Islands' fifteen stars form a ring.
aw|cw: Aruba and Curaçao are both blue with yellow horizontal lines low down and stars near the hoist. Aruba is light blue with two yellow lines and one red four-pointed star; Curaçao is dark blue with one yellow stripe and two white five-pointed stars.
ax|se: Åland and Sweden are both a yellow Nordic cross on blue. Åland adds a red cross inside the yellow one; Sweden's cross is plain yellow.
bb|pt-30: Madeira and Barbados are both vertical blue-gold-blue. Barbados has a black trident head on the gold stripe; Madeira has a red-and-white cross of the Order of Christ.
bl|yt: Saint Barthélemy and Mayotte are both French islands flying a coat of arms on a white field. Mayotte has two seahorses and the word MAYOTTE in red; Saint Barthélemy has two pelicans, a mural crown and the word OUANALAO.
bq-sa|bq-se: Saba and Sint Eustatius are neighbouring Dutch islands whose flags both have a white diamond with a gold star. Saba's corners are plain red and blue triangles; Sint Eustatius has blue panels outlined in red and a green island map in the diamond.
bt|gb-wls: Bhutan and Wales both have a dragon across the whole flag. Wales has a red dragon on white over green; Bhutan has a white dragon on a diagonal split of yellow and orange.
ca|nf: Canada and Norfolk Island both have a wide white central band between colored side bands with a plant symbol in the middle. Canada is red with a red maple leaf; Norfolk Island is green with a green pine tree.
ck|nz: The Cook Islands and New Zealand are both dark blue with the Union Jack in the corner. The Cook Islands have fifteen white stars in a ring; New Zealand has four red stars with white edges in the Southern Cross.
cn|hk: China and Hong Kong both have a red field with five-pointed stars. China has yellow stars in the upper hoist corner; Hong Kong has a white bauhinia flower in the center with small red stars on its petals.
cu|pr: Cuba and Puerto Rico both have five horizontal stripes and a triangle with a white star at the hoist. Cuba has blue stripes and a red triangle; Puerto Rico has red stripes and a blue triangle.
es-pv|gb: The Basque Ikurriña and the Union Jack both lay a diagonal cross under an upright cross. The Ikurriña is red with a green X and a plain white cross; the Union Jack is blue with white and red crosses.
fk|gs: The Falklands and South Georgia are both South Atlantic Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. The Falklands' shield shows a ram above a sailing ship; South Georgia's has a lion with a torch, held up by a seal and a penguin with a reindeer on top.
fk|ky: The Falklands and the Cayman Islands are both Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. The Falklands badge has a white ram above a sailing ship; the Cayman badge has a green turtle and pineapple above three green stars.
fk|pn: The Falklands and Pitcairn are both Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. The Falklands badge has a white ram and a sailing ship; Pitcairn's has an anchor and a Bible, with a wheelbarrow on top.
fk|sh: The Falklands and Saint Helena are both Blue Ensigns with a sailing ship on the badge. The Falklands put a white ram on green grass above the ship; Saint Helena puts a small wirebird on a yellow band above a ship sailing between cliffs.
fo|is: The Faroe Islands and Iceland both have a red Nordic cross edged with the other color. The Faroes have a white field with a blue edge around the cross; Iceland has a blue field with a white edge.
fo|no: The Faroe Islands and Norway both use a red, white and blue Nordic cross. The Faroes have a red cross edged in blue on white; Norway has a blue cross edged in white on red.
fr-20r|it-88: Corsica and Sardinia both show a black Moor's head with a white headband on white. Corsica has a single large head and no cross; Sardinia has four smaller heads separated by a red cross.
fr-bre|us: Brittany and the United States both have horizontal stripes with a decorated canton. The US flag is red, white and blue with 13 stripes and stars; Brittany is black and white with nine stripes and ermine spots.
fr-bre|uy: Brittany and Uruguay both have nine horizontal stripes and a white canton. Uruguay's stripes are white and blue with a gold sun; Brittany's are black and white with black ermine spots.
gb-eng|ge: England and Georgia are both a large red cross on white. England's flag is plain; Georgia adds four small red crosses in the corners.
gb-eng|gg: England and Guernsey are both a red St George's cross on white. England's flag is plain; Guernsey lays a smaller gold cross over the red one.
gb-eng|gg-ald: England and Alderney both have the red cross of St George on white. England's is plain; Alderney adds a green disc with a gold lion at the center.
gb-eng|gg-srk: England and Sark both have the red cross of St George on white. England's is plain; Sark adds a red canton with two gold lions.
gb-eng|it-88: England and Sardinia both have a red cross on white. England's flag is plain; Sardinia adds a black Moor's head in each quarter.
gb|gb-sct: The United Kingdom and Scotland both have a white diagonal cross on blue. Scotland's flag is just the white saltire; the Union Jack adds the red crosses of St George and St Patrick on top.
ge|gg: Georgia and Guernsey both add smaller crosses to a red cross on white. Georgia has four small red crosses in the corners; Guernsey has a single gold cross laid over the center.
ge|it-88: Georgia and Sardinia both have a large red cross on white with something in each quarter. Georgia has four small red crosses; Sardinia has four black Moor's heads.
gg-ald|gg-srk: Alderney and Sark both add Norman lions to the cross of St George. Alderney has one lion on a green disc at the center; Sark has two lions in a red corner patch.
gg|gg-ald: Guernsey and Alderney both lay an emblem over the red cross of St George. Guernsey has a gold cross across the whole flag; Alderney has a green disc with a lion at the center.
gg|gg-srk: Guernsey and Sark both decorate the cross of St George with gold. Guernsey has a gold cross over the red one; Sark has two gold lions in a red upper-hoist corner.
gg|je: Guernsey and Jersey are both white with a red cross and a gold emblem. Guernsey's red cross is upright with a gold cross laid over it; Jersey's is a diagonal X with a crowned red shield at the top.
gi|pl: Gibraltar and Poland are both white over red. Poland's bands are equal and plain; Gibraltar's white band is twice as tall and carries a red castle with a gold key hanging into the red.
gl|pl: Greenland and Poland are both white over red. Poland's flag is plain; Greenland has a disc near the hoist with its colors reversed, red on white and white on red.
gs|sh-ac: South Georgia and Ascension are both Blue Ensigns whose shields are held up by animals. South Georgia's supporters are a fur seal and a penguin; Ascension's are two green sea turtles.
gs|sh-ta: South Georgia and Tristan da Cunha are both Blue Ensigns whose shields are held up by animals. South Georgia's supporters are a fur seal and a penguin with a reindeer on top; Tristan's are two red rock lobsters with a longboat on top.
gu|mp: Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands are both blue Pacific flags with a central emblem. Guam has a red border and an almond-shaped seal with GUAM written on it; the Northern Marianas show a white star on a gray stone inside a flower wreath.
hk|mo: Hong Kong and Macau both have a white flower in the center of a single-colored field. Hong Kong has a five-petalled bauhinia on red; Macau has a lotus on green, under five yellow stars.
hu|iq-kr: Hungary and Kurdistan are both red, white and green horizontal stripes. Hungary's flag is plain; Kurdistan has a gold sun in the center.
im|it-82: The Isle of Man and Sicily both show three bent legs joined at the center. The Isle of Man's legs are armoured on a plain red field; Sicily's are bare, surround Medusa's head with ears of wheat, and sit on a red and yellow diagonal.
iq-kr|ir: Kurdistan and Iran both have red, white and green stripes with an emblem in the center. Kurdistan has red on top and a gold sun; Iran has green on top, a red emblem and white script along the stripe edges.
iq-kr|tj: Kurdistan and Tajikistan are both red, white and green horizontal stripes with a gold emblem in the center. Kurdistan has equal stripes and a 21-rayed sun; Tajikistan has a wider white stripe with a crown under an arc of seven stars.
it-bz|pl: South Tyrol and Poland are both white over red. Poland's flag is plain; South Tyrol has a shield with a red eagle in the center.
jo|mq: Jordan and Martinique both have a red triangle at the hoist with black and green bands. Jordan has three stripes, black, white and green, and a white star in the triangle; Martinique has just two bands, green over black, and its triangle reaches to the center.
ky|tc: The Cayman Islands and Turks and Caicos are both Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. The Cayman badge has a turtle and pineapple on top and three green stars on waves; Turks and Caicos has a plain yellow shield with a conch, a lobster and a cactus.
ky|vg: The Cayman Islands and the British Virgin Islands are both Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. The Cayman badge has a lion, three green stars and a turtle on top; the BVI shield is green with a woman in white surrounded by lamps.
lb|pf: Lebanon and French Polynesia are both red-white-red with a white band twice as tall as the red ones. Lebanon has a green cedar tree in the center; French Polynesia has a canoe in front of a golden sun above blue waves.
mq|ps: Martinique and Palestine both have a red triangle at the hoist with black and green bands. Palestine has three stripes, black, white and green; Martinique has only two, green on top and black below, with no white.
ms|vg: Montserrat and the British Virgin Islands are both Blue Ensigns whose badge shows a woman. Montserrat's woman wears green and holds a harp and a cross; the BVI's is dressed in white on a green shield surrounded by lamps.
nf|ng: Nigeria and Norfolk Island are both green-white-green vertical stripes. Nigeria's flag is plain; Norfolk Island has a green pine tree on the white band.
ph|sx: The Philippines and Sint Maarten both have two horizontal bands of blue and red with a white triangle at the hoist. The Philippines has blue on top with a gold sun and three stars; Sint Maarten has red on top with a coat of arms and pelican.
pn|sh: Pitcairn and Saint Helena are both Blue Ensigns with a coat of arms in the fly. Pitcairn's shows an anchor, a Bible and a wheelbarrow; Saint Helena's shows a wirebird above a sailing ship between cliffs.
sh-ac|sh-ta: Ascension and Tristan da Cunha are both Blue Ensigns with a shield held by sea creatures. Ascension's supporters are green turtles with a ship above; Tristan's are red rock lobsters with a longboat and naval crown above.
sh|sh-ac: Saint Helena and Ascension are both Blue Ensigns from the same territory with a shield in the fly. Saint Helena's shield shows a ship between cliffs under a wirebird; Ascension's has three white terns and is held by two green turtles.
sh|sh-ta: Saint Helena and Tristan da Cunha are both Blue Ensigns from the same territory with a shield in the fly. Saint Helena's shield shows a ship between cliffs; Tristan's shows albatrosses and is held by two rock lobsters.
tc|vg: Turks and Caicos and the British Virgin Islands are both Blue Ensigns with a shield in the fly. Turks and Caicos' shield is yellow with a conch, a lobster and a cactus; the BVI's is green with a woman in white and lamps.
tz|zanzibar: Tanzania and Zanzibar share the same green, yellow, black and blue diagonal design. Tanzania's covers the whole flag; Zanzibar shrinks it into the canton over stripes of blue, black and green.
